verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party webhooks product: developers subscribe to event notifications and verify and validate each delivery, which implies signed payloads. Webhook event logs get a passing mention alongside API Logs. Missing for 10: any evidence of automatic delivery retries or a retry policy, any event replay/redelivery capability, detail on the signature scheme beyond a link title, depth on what the event logs expose, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state

citations.quote: Verify and Validate an Event Notification
